file_metadata.scope: Physical choreography of all services: doors, curtain, censing, vestments, bows, hand positions, clergy movement
file_metadata.description: Machine-queryable encoding of the Ordo's General Rules (§1–§28) and per-service door/curtain state protocols. Each rule cites its Ordo §-number. Supersedes all prior Dolnytsky Part I references.

§1.rule: Sanctuary at least one step higher than nave. No steps within sanctuary to Holy Table.

§2.rule: Holy Table is square, detached from wall, centered. Prothesis table on north wall, vestment table on south wall.

§3.rule: Artophorion (tabernacle) centered on Holy Table, shaped like small church or sepulcher. Must not obstruct celebrant or concelebrants.

§4.rule: Candelabra on Holy Table must not overcrowd it. One candelabrum (1-3 candles) per side of cross or artophorion. Seven-branched oil candelabrum placed behind Holy Table.

§5.rule: No reliquaries, flowers, or unnecessary items on Holy Table. Service book on pillow upon Holy Table, or on analogion to left side.

§6.rule: Iconostasis: Savior icon to right of central doors, Theotokos to left. Parecclesiae need own iconostasis; Holy Table without iconostasis is unsuitable.

§7.rule: Only priests, deacons, clerics, and servers may enter Altar. No laity, especially women, regardless of status.

§8.rule: Diskarion (paten) must be large, with rim; may have stem-base.

§9.rule: Thurible has short chains for full-length swing.

§10.rule: No vestments or linens beyond those prescribed. No bells, organs, or harmoniums.

small_bow.description: Incline head and shoulders while making sign of Cross. Do NOT extend hand to knees or ground.

single.note: At 'Blessed is our God' or 'Through the prayers'
When coming before doors for reading/chanting

triple.note: Once per each threefold Alleluia (3x total)

exceptions.gospel_begin_end: Sign of Cross WITHOUT inclining head/shoulders
exceptions.deacon_to_priest: Deacon inclines head/shoulders to priest before leaving Altar for ektenies and when returning

great_bow_prostration.description: Sign of Cross then prostrate entire body to ground.

elevated_hands.description: Hands extended and elevated. Elbows must NOT touch sides; hands freely extended on high.

default_positions.description: When no posture prescribed, hands may be: on Holy Table, holding service book, under phelonion, or crossed on breast. NEVER joined finger-to-finger.

deacon_orarion.rule: While reciting ektenies, deacon raises orarion with three fingers of right hand. Priest may begin reading silent prayer as soon as deacon begins petitions.

head_bowing.rule: At 'Bow your heads to the Lord' — all incline head and shoulders.

kneeling.rule: Servers do NOT kneel in Altar during Divine Liturgy. People may kneel if they desire.

priestly_blessing_hand.rule: Thumb of right hand over ring finger, index finger extended, middle and little fingers slightly bent. Recipients bow head/shoulders and sign themselves with Cross.

doors_and_curtain.description: General rules for opening/closing royal doors and veil (curtain).

side_doors.rule: Always closed unless someone must pass through.

transitions.note: Opened when priest censes at beginning

divine_liturgy.note: In some places, custom to open/close more often.

bright_week.rule: Royal doors AND side doors remain open during entire Bright Week, even during Communion of celebrant.

hierarchical_service.rule: Royal doors always remain open while a bishop celebrates.

curtain_veil.vespers_and_orthros: Open throughout all of Vespers and Orthros.

regional_variation.note: Some regions keep royal doors and veil open from beginning to end of Chrysostom/Basil Liturgy. At Presanctified, after 'Let my prayer arise' doors/veil are not closed after Entrance. This practice is NOT to be extended to other regions.

§20.incense_loading: Server or deacon loads thurible and presents to priest for blessing. Priest is NOT the only one who loads incense.
§20.sign_of_cross: Laudable for priest/deacon to make sign of Cross with thurible before censing.
§20.reverence: When censing any person or object, slightly incline head and shoulders.

§21.first_blessing: First incense blessing in any service: 'We offer incense to You...'
§21.subsequent: All other times in same service: 'Blessed is our God...'

§22.rule: When vesting for any service, vestments are blessed and kissed as at Prothesis (§103-106). Same procedure for other services but prayers omitted.

§23.rule: Priest not wearing sticharion should wear rason (Greek: rason / Slavonic: riasa) over cassock.

§24.rule: No one may wear vestment proper to an Order superior to his own.

daily_vespers_matins.note: Over rason/cassock. Phelonion added at Entrance and other prescribed moments.

vigil_vespers.note: Phelonion blessed and kissed before Entrance.

divine_liturgy_full.note: Per Ordo §103–106. Epigonation on right thigh if entitled.

presanctified_communion.note: Orarion bound crosswise at Communion per §244.

§25.one_deacon: Stands at priest's right unless otherwise prescribed.
§25.two_deacons: First deacon at priest's right, second at priest's left.

§26.rule: Only ordained deacons may function in the office of a deacon.

concelebration_voice.rule: Raised-voice phrases by priest/deacon are NOT recited in subdued voice by other concelebrants, except ekphoneses concluding prayers and unless otherwise prescribed.

variant_system.rule: Complete ceremonies explained in section with one deacon. Other sections (two deacons, without deacon, concelebrants) explain only what differs.

variants.label: With the Ministry of One Deacon
With the Ministry of Two Deacons
Without the Ministry of a Deacon

sequence.note: Beginning with Savior icon, via north door
From soleas or by processing down aisle
One from right, other from left

§29.deacon: Holds sticharion and orarion, approaches priest, head bowed: 'Master, bless.' Priest blesses: 'Blessed is our God.' Deacon: 'Amen.' Dons sticharion, kisses orarion, places on left shoulder.

§30.priest: Already wearing rason. Blesses epitrachelion, puts it on. Exits via north door, stands before closed royal doors. Small bow. 'Blessed is our God.' After Our Father: 'For Thine is the kingdom.'

§31.priest: Quietly reads all Prayers of Light before royal doors.
§31.deacon: After Psalm, exits via north door, small bow to priest, begins Great Synapte.
§31.after_ekphonesis: Deacon makes small bow, returns via south door, stands at priest's right.

§32.deacon: Exits via north door, says Small Synapte. After ekphonesis, small bow, returns to Altar.

§33.deacon: Takes thurible, presents to priest for blessing. Full censing: Holy Table (4 sides), apsidal icon, altar icons, priest. Exits via north door, censes iconostasis (south from Savior, north from Theotokos), choirs, people from soleas. Returns via south door.

§34.priest: Blesses and kisses phelonion, vests. At Glory, priest and deacon come before Holy Table. Royal doors opened. Deacon takes thurible, receives blessing. Preceded by candlebearers, they go around Holy Table from right, exit via north door. Stand before royal doors. Deacon says 'Let us pray to the Lord.' Priest says Prayer of Entrance. Deacon points orarion east: 'Master, bless the holy entrance.' Priest blesses: 'Blessed is the entrance.' Deacon makes sign of Cross with thurible or elevates Gospel, exclaims 'Wisdom! Stand aright!' They enter Altar. Deacon censes as at §33.

§35.deacon: Comes to royal doors: 'Let us be attentive!' Priest blesses: 'Peace be with all.' Deacon: 'Wisdom! Be attentive!' After prokeimenon and lessons, priest returns to Holy Table. Deacon walks around table, exits via north door, says ektene 'Let us all say' and aitisis 'Let us complete.' After ekphonesis, deacon returns via south door.

§36.note: After troparia, royal doors opened. Deacon exits via south door, stands near Savior icon, elevates orarion: 'Wisdom!' Priest says Dismissal from center of royal doors. Then returns through royal doors; deacon via south door. Royal doors closed. Small bow before Holy Table. Unvest.

§37.deacon: First deacon departs via north door, says Great Synapte. Second deacon remains inside Altar.

§38.deacon: Second deacon departs via north door, says Small Synapte. Returns to Altar via south door.

§39.deacon: Both deacons take thuribles. Coordinated censing per §39: cense Holy Table (both front/back, first deacon right, second deacon left), icons, priest. First deacon censes south iconostasis and right choir, second deacon censes north iconostasis and left choir. Both cense people from soleas.

§40.deacon: At Entrance, exit order: candlebearers, second deacon, first deacon, priest. First deacon says 'Let us pray to the Lord.' Priest says Entrance Prayer. First deacon asks blessing. Exclaims 'Wisdom! Stand aright!'

§41.deacon: Deacons show reverence to priest, leave Altar: second deacon via north door, first deacon via south door. Litanies: first deacon says ektene, second deacon says aitisis.

§42.deacon: Royal doors opened. Deacons leave via own doors, stand before royal doors facing one another. First deacon (near Savior icon) raises orarion: 'Wisdom!' Both keep oraria raised during Dismissal. Enter Altar via own doors. Royal doors closed.

two_deacons.note: Litanies distributed: 1st deacon = Great Synapte + ektene, 2nd deacon = Small Synapte + aitisis. Censing coordinated per §39. At Entrance, exit order: 2nd deacon, then 1st deacon, then priest. At Dismissal, both keep oraria raised.

§43.rule: Priest performs all diaconal parts EXCEPT: 'Let us pray to the Lord' and 'Master, bless.'

§44.priest: Says before royal doors. After ekphonesis, returns to Altar via south door.

§45.priest: Says Small Synapte. At 'Lord, I have cried' censes as §33. Enters Altar via south door.

§46.priest: Takes thurible or Gospel. Goes around Holy Table from right, exits via north door. Bows before royal doors. Says Entrance Prayer. Blesses entrance with right hand, kisses Gospel. Makes sign of Cross with thurible or elevates Gospel: 'Wisdom! Stand aright!' Enters Altar through royal doors.

§47.priest: Comes to royal doors: 'Let us be attentive!' Blesses: 'Peace be with all.' 'Wisdom! Be attentive!' For lessons, turns to Holy Table and exclaims from behind it.

§48.priest: Returns to Holy Table. Says ektene and aitisis there.

§49.priest: Faces people. 'Wisdom!' Says Dismissal from royal doors.

§50.rule: Concelebrants (usually even number) vest in epitrachelion and phelonion over rason just before Entrance. Stand at sides of Holy Table, NOT in front. Order: 1st to right, 2nd to left, 3rd to right, etc.

§51.rule: All make small bow. Phelonia hanging freely, hands lowered. Younger priests precede. Exit via north door. Stand in double file at royal doors. Principal celebrant in center behind. Only principal says Entrance Prayer.

§52.rule: 'For You are merciful' by principal. 'For You, O God, are gracious' may be by 1st concelebrant. 'May the might of Your kingdom' by principal.

vigil_choreography._source: Ordo §53–§73 (Section III: Vespers With All-Night Vigil)
vigil_choreography.note: Follows Vespers Without Vigil pattern with additions: opening censing with 'Command!', Litiya procession to narthex, Artoklasia (5 loaves blessing), transition to Orthros.

one_deacon_key_additions.§54: Priest opens royal doors. Deacon exits via north door with candle: 'Command!' Returns. Priest censes (full). 'Bless, O Lord.' Enter Altar. 'Glory to the Holy Trinity.' Psalm 103.
one_deacon_key_additions.§57: Litiya: Priest with hand cross + deacon with thurible exit to narthex. Stichera, petitions, blessing of loaves.
one_deacon_key_additions.§60: Transition to Orthros: Priest closes doors, removes phelonion. Six Psalms begin.

§59.two_deacons: Both deacons exit via northern door carrying thuribles, preceding the concelebrating priests. First deacon censes the tetrapod and the icons.
§59.one_deacon: Deacon carrying thurible exits via northern door, preceding the priest, and censes the tetrapod.
§59.without_deacon: Priest carrying hand cross and censer exits via Holy Doors, precedes to the narthex.

§61.with_deacon: First deacon raises orarion with three fingers of right hand and exclaims the Litiya petitions: 'O God, save Your people...'
§61.without_deacon: Priest exclaims the Litiya petitions from the soleas or narthex.

§63.rule: Priest censes the five loaves, wheat, wine, and oil in the form of a cross (three times), then reads the prayer of blessing.

key_moments.§76: Six Psalms: Priest reads Orthros prayers at Holy Table. After first 3 psalms, exits via north door to read before royal doors.
key_moments.§78: Prokeimenon: Royal doors opened. Priest vests in phelonion. Deacon censes Holy Table (4 sides) and rest per §33.
key_moments.§79: Gospel: Priest takes Gospel through royal doors, stands on soleas, reads facing people on analogion.
key_moments.§80: Anointing (Vigil only): Priest with hand cross exits through royal doors. Deacon takes blessed oil and quill, exits via north door. Priest anoints foreheads at tetrapod.
key_moments.§82: Great Doxology: Royal doors opened. Priest in phelonion before altar.

§76.concelebration: Clergy exit the Altar through the Holy Doors. Concelebrating priests precede in reverse order of dignity (younger first), followed by the principal celebrant, and stand around the tetrapod.
§76.single_priest: Priest exits the Altar through the Holy Doors and stands before the tetrapod in the center of the nave.

§79.with_deacon: Deacon censes the Holy Table on all four sides, the Altar, the iconostasis, the priest, and the people.
§79.without_deacon: Priest censes the Holy Table on all four sides, the iconostasis, and the people.

key_moments.§100: Preparatory prayers: Priest and deacon make 3 small bows before royal doors, facing east.
key_moments.§101: Enter Altar: Priest via south door, deacon via north door, saying 'I will come into Your house.'
key_moments.§105: Priest vesting order: sticharion, epitrachelion, zone, epimanikia, [epigonation], phelonion.
key_moments.§122: Little Entrance: Candlebearers, then deacon with Gospel, then priest. Prayer of Entrance before royal doors.
key_moments.§128: Cherubic Hymn: Hands elevated. Threefold recitation with small bows. Censing follows.
key_moments.§129: Great Entrance: Deacon carries diskarion on head, priest carries chalice. Enter through royal doors.
key_moments.§134: Institution Narrative: Single blessing over bread. Right hand extended toward diskos: 'Take, eat.' Deep bow with sign of Cross.
key_moments.§140: Communion of priest: Body first, then Blood. Wipes lips and chalice edge with lention.

§115.rule: Priest arranges the Lamb on the diskos, places the asterisk over it, covers diskos and chalice with small veils, covers both with the aer, and places them on the Prothesis table.

§122.with_deacon: Deacon takes the Gospel book, exits via northern door preceding the priest, exclaims 'Wisdom! Stand aright!', and enters Altar.
§122.without_deacon: Priest takes the Gospel book, exits via northern door, exclaims 'Wisdom! Stand aright!', and enters Altar.

§129.with_deacon: Deacon carries the diskarion on his head, preceding the priest who carries the chalice. They exit via northern door and enter via Holy Doors.
§129.without_deacon: Priest carries both the diskarion (left hand) and the chalice (right hand), exits via northern door, and enters via Holy Doors.

key_moments.§226: Transfer of Presanctified Lamb: From artophorion on Holy Table to Prothesis table. Carried on diskarion with veil.
key_moments.§234: 'Command!' Light and thurible. 'The Light of Christ illumines all.' Three great prostrations.
key_moments.§235: 'Let my prayer ascend': Priest censes Holy Table on 4 sides during Psalm 140 verses.
key_moments.§241: Great Entrance: Priest takes veiled diskarion and chalice. Complete silence maintained.
key_moments.§244: Deacon binds orarion crosswise at Communion.

§226.rule: Priest transfers the Presanctified Lamb from the artophorion on the Holy Table to the diskos on the Prothesis table in complete silence.

§235.rule: Priest censes the Holy Table on all four sides, the Prothesis table, the icons, and the people during Psalm 140 verses.

§241.with_deacon: Deacon walks backwards censing the Holy Gifts carried by the priest during complete silence.
§241.without_deacon: Priest carries the Holy Gifts in complete silence; no censing is performed.
